Banks' Opening Status on Saturday, September 19, 2026, Clarified

Major Indian banks, including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and State Bank of India (SBI), were confirmed to be open on Saturday, September 19, 2026. This clarification addressed public queries regarding bank operations on the specific date, which some may have mistaken for a holiday. The information confirmed that banking services were available to customers across various cities on this day.
